name: Queue-Fair FREE Virtual Waiting Room
author: queuefair

sections.description:
Queue-Fair, the original patented online queue for busy websites, is the top rated Virtual Waiting Room in the world, according to review site G2.

When your site has more visitors than it can handle gracefully, the excess visitors are automatically sent away from your webservers to a branded online queue – it then sends visitors back to your site in first-come, first-served order at the rate that you desire, protecting your WordPress from web crashes due to high demand.

Our retail clients report that visitors who have seen a Queue Page add around 20% more to their shopping baskets.

You can get a free Queue-Fair Virtual Waiting Room for your WordPress with this plugin and a Queue-Fair Free Tier account from Queue-Fair.com.

We queue hundreds of thousands of people every day.

By using the world’s most accurate, highest quality, most powerful and best value Virtual Waiting Room platform, you ensure that your site can keep selling at its optimum transaction rate. Your site visitors, shoppers, ticket buyers, and app users always get the responsive experience they require, even when you are really busy. They won’t see a crashed site.

More Orders
Even the world’s biggest companies get overwhelmed by peaks in demand, particularly sudden peaks. All webservers have limits, and when they are exceeded, your visitors experience a crashed site. Queue-Fair stops traffic peaks from crashing your site.

More Customers
Queue-Fair means you can serve new customers even when your servers are too busy to handle them. People who see an error page or no response at all from your site are unlikely to return – but you can reach all these people with Queue-Fair.

More Reliable
Use Queue-Fair for timed events and onsales, as well as 24 hour always-on SafeGuard protection from unexpected peaks.

More Secure
This plugin gives you our Server-Side Adapter, adapted for WordPress, for secure and unskippable queues when things get busy on your site..

You will need to create a Free Tier account at Queue-Fair.com – we can upgrade you to Unlimited Service if you are running a larger/busier site.

External services

This Adapter runs in SAFE mode by default, which means it will connect to the Queue-Fair servers (at youraccount.queue-fair.net) on the first visit from each new visitor to a page that matches the Activation Rules that you set in the Queue-Fair portal, in order to check if the visitor needs to join a queue. The information sent is the visitor’s browser’s user agent, and the visitor’s IP address. It is possible to have the Adapter run in SIMPLE mode instead, which does not make this call – if that is required for your use-case please contact Queue-Fair support for assistance.

The Adapter will also download your queue settings, including the Activation Rules for your queues, once every 5 minutes from files.queue-fair.net, as is usual for all our server-side Adapters. No visitor information is sent on a settings download request. The downloaded settings file is cached in uploads/queue-fair-virtual-waiting-room/, the WordPress-recommended location for this kind of file.

For further details see Our PHP Adapter Github repository, the Technical Guide in the Help section of the Queue-Fair Portal, or the Queue-Fair Developers Page.

The Queue-Fair Virtual Waiting Room service is provided by Orderly Telecoms Ltd Terms of use Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
Easy installation

You can install a Queue-Fair Virtual Waiting Room on your site in the same way as any other plugin, using the WordPress plugin directory.

Manual installation

  1. Download the Queue-Fair plugin as a zip file
  2. Unzip queue-fair-wordpress-plugin.zip
  3. Upload the queue-fair folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  4. Activate the Queue-Fair plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

Configuration

After installation, you need to configure the plugin:

  1. If you don’t already have one, go to https://queue-fair.com/sign-up to create a free Queue-Fair account.
  2. Log into your account in the Queue-Fair Portal
  3. Go to the Account -> Your Account page
  4. Copy and paste your Account System Name and Account Secret into the plugin Config screen in WordPress (from the left nav)
  5. If you were formerly using our Client-Side JavaScript Adapter, remove it – you don’t need it any more.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Queue-Fair account to use this plugin?

Yes! You can get a Free Tier account at queue-fair.com/sign-up. We can upgrade any Free Tier account to Unlimited Service when you are ready.

I’ve set things up, but how do I configure my queue?

This plugin installs a Server-Side Adapter into your WordPress. Once that’s done, you configure your queues using the Queue-Fair Portal. If you need help, read the Technical Guide in the Help section of the Portal, or book a free Consultation at calendly.com/queue-fair – we’re always happy to chat!

Where can I get more help with setting things up?

You’ll receive a copy of our Technical Guide when you set up your Free Tier account. You might also find the resources on our Developer’s Page helpful.

How about a Privacy Policy?

Sure no problem! That’s at queue-fair.com/privacy.

What cookies are used by Queue-Fair and for what purposes?

Please see the Technical Guide in the Help section of the Portal.

Is Queue-Fair GDPR compliant?

Yes! If you have a specific question about privacy, or anything else, please go ahead and ask us – you can contact support from the Help section of the Portal.

How do I remove Queue-Fair from my site?

You can deactivate the plugin for a temporary disabling, or uninstall it to remove it completely.
